required_monitors.name: ops_monitor
required_monitors.signal: dead letters, stuck jobs, stale approvals, failed runs, and model-spend anomalies

required_monitors.name: synthetic_monitor
required_monitors.signal: health, login, profile, loop run, approval, receipt, and logout

rollback_triggers.signal: Production web/API smoke or synthetic monitor fails after deploy.
rollback_triggers.decision: Roll back the web/API deploy through the host provider.
rollback_triggers.operator_action: Keep outbox disabled until smoke passes on the restored deployment.

rollback_triggers.signal: Loop worker produces repeated failures, stuck jobs, or dead-letter jobs.
rollback_triggers.decision: Disable the loop worker workflow and keep ops monitor enabled as the incident signal.
rollback_triggers.operator_action: Repair or cancel unsafe jobs through the admin worker-job API before re-enabling.

rollback_triggers.signal: Outbox worker produces repeated failed or dead-letter delivery rows.
rollback_triggers.decision: Disable the outbox worker workflow and switch email provider to in-app if needed.
rollback_triggers.operator_action: Fix provider configuration, rerun preflight and ops monitor, then dispatch one manual worker run.

rollback_triggers.signal: Production migration apply fails or targets the wrong Supabase project.
rollback_triggers.decision: Stop deploys and ship a forward-fix migration; use PITR only for destructive corruption.
rollback_triggers.operator_action: Run RLS live verification and the beta release gate on the exact repair commit.
